name: set-noon
description: DEV TIME-CHEAT demo: set the celestial time-of-day to local noon (sun overhead) at the player's current surface position, then a screenshot to capture the lit scene.
_notes: Requires ORBITAL_SKY on (the celestial clock must exist) and CONTROL_ENABLED baked on at export + a live grant. set_time folds a persistent f64 offset into the ONE ephemeris clock, so sun+moon+planets+day-night all re-orient together. local_hours=12 puts the sun at its daily-max elevation for the player's latitude; 0 = midnight; sun_elev_deg (optional, [-90,90]) instead lands the sun at that elevation. The step passes through flight.mjs's generic {...s} spread exactly like look — no per-op harness code.

legs.name: set local noon (sun highest at the player)
